agoras
Documentation Install GitHub PyPI

Publish and delete posts on ten social networks from one command.

Agoras is a Python command line utility for X, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Discord, YouTube, TikTok, Threads, Telegram and WhatsApp. Authorize once, then post, thread, upload video or delete — by hand or from CI.

$ pip install agoras
Get started Read the docs

Supported networks

One CLI, one credential store, one content format. Each platform keeps its own guide and its own action set.

X Facebook Instagram LinkedIn Discord YouTube TikTok Threads Telegram WhatsApp

Authorize once, post many times

Credentials are stored encrypted under ~/.agoras/tokens/. OAuth platforms refresh their own tokens; action commands never take credential flags. 

# once, per platform
agoras x authorize \
  --consumer-key "$CONSUMER_KEY" \
  --consumer-secret "$CONSUMER_SECRET"

# as often as you like
agoras x post --text "Hello World"
agoras facebook video --video-url clip.mp4 \
  --video-title "My Video"

Built for automation

Content files, environment variables and GitHub Actions let the same command run unchanged on a laptop or in a pipeline. 

# post.yaml
text: Hello World
media:
  - url: https://example.com/image.png

$ agoras x post --content post.yaml

See content files and the GitHub action.

Modular by design

Install the whole CLI, or only the layers you need. Platform support, core logic, media handling and shared utilities ship as separate packages. 

agoras (CLI)
└── agoras-platforms
    └── agoras-core
        ├── agoras-media
        └── agoras-common

What you get

  • Platform-first CLI — agoras x post instead of a flag maze.
  • OAuth callback server — browser-based authorization where the network supports it.
  • Encrypted token store — re-authorize once, not every run.
  • Delete and thread actions alongside posting, with the same content rules.
